repo.sheets.py:
"""Pages of readings."""


def page_count(n_items, page_size):
    """Return how many pages are needed to show n_items, page_size to a page."""
    return n_items // page_size


def page(readings, number, page_size):
    """Return page `number` of readings. Pages are numbered from 1."""
    start = (number - 1) * page_size
    return readings[start:start + page_size]


def all_pages(readings, page_size):
    """Return every page of readings, in order."""
    return [page(readings, n, page_size) for n in range(1, page_count(len(readings), page_size) + 1)]
repo.tests/test_visible.py:
from readings import load_readings, ROWS
from sheets import all_pages, page_count


def test_last_items_present():
    pages = all_pages(list(load_readings()), 4)
    assert sum(len(p) for p in pages) == len(ROWS)


def test_exact_fit():
    assert page_count(6, 3) == 2
    assert len(all_pages(list(load_readings())[:4], 2)) == 2
